statements.text: When Eli Lilly trades about 2 % below its all-time high inside a sideways phase on steady volume, the price rose in 87 % of 15 independent cases within 2 trading days.
When Eli Lilly trades at its all-time high on falling volume, the price rose in 75 % of 12 independent cases within 5 trading days.
After a fall of 20 % from its all-time high, Eli Lilly came back every time: in all 4 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 12 months at most.
